evidence_quotes: Relativiteitsvereiste. Waterwet strekt niet tot bescherming van de belangen van eiseressen. Beroep ongegrond.
rationale: This Dutch administrative court decision (Rechtbank Den Haag) directly adjudicates the protective scope (relativiteitsvereiste / Schutznorm) of the Dutch Water Act (Waterwet), holding that the Waterwet does not serve to protect the interests of the plaintiffs and dismissing the appeal as unfounded. Because the ruling substantively interprets and applies statutory water governance norms under the Waterwet in an administrative appeal, both mananciais_calibrated_label and strict_service_access_label are WATER, categorized under regulatory_permit (Waterwet litigation), with no household service connection refusal or informal settlement issue involved.
